 Pune Weather Update Hints At Cooler Days After Recent Rise In Temperature 
 News 
 October 24, 2026 by Aashlesha Kakde 
 Pune might continue experiencing warm afternoons over the weekend as the India Meteorological Department (IMD) have forecasted daytime temperatures of around 35°C on Saturday and Sunday. Minimum temperatures might hover at 19°C on Saturday before rising slightly to 20°C on Sunday.
 The forecast indicates largely clear conditions during the morning as cloud cover likely to increase later in the day. Partly cloudy skies may develop by afternoon or evening, although temperatures might remain relatively high. ( Pune News ) The outlook follows a recent spell of uncomfortable heat in the city. Pune recorded a maximum temperature of 35°C and a minimum of 18.5°C on Friday, with cloud cover appearing at intervals through the day. While the immediate forecast suggests little change in daytime temperatures, residents may have to wait longer for a noticeable drop in the mercury. Meanwhile, a developing weather system over the Bay of Bengal might intensify over the coming days. It is forecast to strengthen into a deep depression on Sunday and develop into a cyclonic storm over the west-central Bay of Bengal by Monday morning. The system’s development will be closely watched for its wider weather implications. For Pune, however, the current local outlook points to warm conditions through the weekend as afternoon and evening cloudiness offering some variation in an otherwise largely clear forecast. ( Pune News )
